## URLs to register for your app

Your SPA runs at `http://localhost:5173` and the API at `http://localhost:5138`. Register the SPA as a `SINGLE_PAGE` app (no client secret, PKCE `S256`):

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Redirect URLs | `http://localhost:5173/callback` |
| Post-logout redirect URLs | `http://localhost:5173/` |
| Allowed web origins (CORS) | `http://localhost:5173` |

Two things specific to your setup:
- If you open the client at `http://127.0.0.1:5173` (the dev server also listens there), register the `127.0.0.1` variants too — redirect URIs are exact-match and the two hosts are different origins.
- The API needs **no** redirect URLs. The browser never redirects to `http://localhost:5138`, and Vite proxies `/api` so API calls stay same-origin. Register the API separately only to define its scopes/audience.

For production, substitute your deployed host: `https://your-app-host/callback`, `https://your-app-host/`, `https://your-app-host`.

## What changed

Client:
- src/auth/oidcConfig.ts — PKCE settings, `sessionStorage` token store, silent renew, callback handler that restores the hash route.
- src/auth/RequireAuth.tsx — guards Notes; Home and Contacts stay public.
- src/auth/AuthControls.tsx — header login/logout and signed-in email.
- src/NotesPage.tsx — sends `Authorization: Bearer` on notes requests.
- `.env.example` — copy to `.env.local` and set `` and ``.

Server (`Program.cs`):
- JWT bearer validation of signature, issuer, audience, and lifetime against `Cidaas:Authority`.
- `.RequireAuthorization()` on all four notes endpoints; `/api/hello` stays anonymous.
- Startup fails with a clear message if `Cidaas:Authority`/`Cidaas:Audience` are unset, so notes are never served unprotected. Set them with `dotnet user-secrets` (see README).

## Verification

Lint, client build, and `dotnet build Appka.slnx` pass. Against a running API: `GET /api/hello` → 200, while anonymous `GET`/`POST /api/notes` and a bogus bearer token → 401. In the browser, Notes is blocked until configured; Home and Contacts render normally.

Not verified: a real login round-trip and token validation, which need your tenant values in `.env.local` and user secrets. One caveat from the guide worth checking first — decode a real access token and confirm `aud` matches `Cidaas:Audience`, and that roles arrive in a `roles` claim.
